title: Army R&D golden age and institutions to study ET technology
summary: UAPGerb tells of Army R&D golden age and institutions to study ET technology, about 1959-1960s at United States (no place named), and summarises it without a named source. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: the exact time of the golden age of army R&D under Corso. um who said that there were institutions also created to study uh extraterrestrial technology.

plain: A UFO researcher who goes by the online name UAPGerb told podcast host Jesse Michels that the 1960s were a golden age of US Army research and development, at the time a man named Philip Corso was involved, alongside a man named Arthur Trudeau. UAPGerb says Corso claimed that institutions were also set up then to study technology from beings not from Earth, and he points to Army research primers, booklets from that time, as backing for the period. If true, it would mean the Army was quietly studying alien technology decades ago.
